opcodes.name: DISPATCH
opcodes.description: An event was dispatched. `t` is the event name and `s` the sequence number; `d` is described per event.

opcodes.name: HEARTBEAT
opcodes.description: Keeps the connection alive. `d` is the last sequence number received, or null.

opcodes.name: IDENTIFY
opcodes.description: Starts a new session.

opcodes.name: PRESENCE_UPDATE
opcodes.description: Updates the client's presence.

opcodes.name: VOICE_STATE_UPDATE
opcodes.description: Joins, moves between or leaves voice channels.

opcodes.name: RESUME
opcodes.description: Resumes a previous session within the resume window.

opcodes.name: RECONNECT
opcodes.description: The client should reconnect and resume.

opcodes.name: REQUEST_GUILD_MEMBERS
opcodes.description: Requests guild members; answered with GUILD_MEMBERS_CHUNK dispatches.

opcodes.name: INVALID_SESSION
opcodes.description: The session is invalid. `d` tells whether it can be resumed.

opcodes.name: HELLO
opcodes.description: Sent immediately after connecting; carries the heartbeat interval.

opcodes.name: HEARTBEAT_ACK
opcodes.description: Acknowledges a heartbeat.

opcodes.name: E2EE_ENVELOPE
opcodes.description: Ephemeral-mode MLS ciphertext. Client to gateway carries every recipient; gateway to client carries only the receiving device's entry.

opcodes.name: E2EE_ACK
opcodes.description: Acknowledges ephemeral messages; the gateway deletes them from this device's inbox.

opcodes.name: P2P_SIGNAL
opcodes.description: P2P-mode WebRTC signaling. Relayed only, never persisted.

opcodes.name: VOICE_TELEMETRY
opcodes.description: Client voice quality sample, published to discordy.telemetry.v1.

opcodes.name: WATCH_TOGETHER
opcodes.description: Watch Together playback synchronisation.

opcodes.name: CALL_DECLINE
opcodes.description: Declines the DM call ringing in a channel. The caller's call stops ringing for this user.

opcodes.name: CALL_RING
opcodes.description: Rings 1 to 10 members of a DM channel for a call the sender is in.

close_codes.name: UNKNOWN_OPCODE
close_codes.description: An invalid opcode or payload for an opcode was sent.

close_codes.name: NOT_AUTHENTICATED
close_codes.description: A payload was sent before identifying.

close_codes.name: AUTHENTICATION_FAILED
close_codes.description: The token in IDENTIFY was invalid.

close_codes.name: ALREADY_AUTHENTICATED
close_codes.description: More than one IDENTIFY was sent.

close_codes.name: INVALID_SEQ
close_codes.description: The sequence sent when resuming was invalid.

close_codes.name: RATE_LIMITED
close_codes.description: More than 120 payloads were sent within 60 seconds.

close_codes.name: INVALID_INTENTS
close_codes.description: An invalid intent bitfield was sent.

close_codes.name: DISALLOWED_INTENTS
close_codes.description: A privileged intent was requested that the application is not approved for.

close_codes.name: SERVER_OVERLOADED
close_codes.description: The gateway is short of memory and refuses new connections. Reconnect with backoff.

dispatch_events.name: RESUMED
dispatch_events.description: Replay after RESUME has finished. `d` is null.

dispatch_events.name: VOICE_SERVER_UPDATE
dispatch_events.description: The voice node allocated for a guild or DM call.

dispatch_events.name: CALL_CREATE
dispatch_events.description: A DM call started (its first participant joined). Sent to the channel's recipients; `ringing` lists the recipients being rung.

dispatch_events.name: CALL_UPDATE
dispatch_events.description: A DM call's ringing recipients or voice states changed.

dispatch_events.name: CALL_DELETE
dispatch_events.description: The last participant left the DM call.

dispatch_events.name: GUILD_CREATE
dispatch_events.description: A guild became available or the user joined one.

dispatch_events.name: GUILD_DELETE
dispatch_events.description: A guild became unavailable or the user left it.

dispatch_events.name: CHANNEL_CREATE
dispatch_events.description: A channel was created. DM channels are published on discordy.user.v1 with target_user_ids.

dispatch_events.name: GUILD_MEMBER_REMOVE
dispatch_events.description: A user left or was removed from a guild.

dispatch_events.name: THREAD_MEMBERS_UPDATE
dispatch_events.description: Thread membership changed; underscore-prefixed bus state is private to the gateway.

dispatch_events.name: MESSAGE_DELETE_BULK
dispatch_events.description: Several messages were deleted at once.

dispatch_events.name: MESSAGE_POLL_VOTE_ADD
dispatch_events.description: Authoritative poll counts and complete actor selection after a vote add.

dispatch_events.name: MESSAGE_POLL_VOTE_REMOVE
dispatch_events.description: Authoritative poll counts and complete actor selection after a vote remove.

dispatch_events.name: MESSAGE_REACTION_ADD
dispatch_events.description: A user reacted to a message.

dispatch_events.name: MESSAGE_REACTION_REMOVE_ALL
dispatch_events.description: All reactions were removed from a message.

dispatch_events.name: CHANNEL_PINS_UPDATE
dispatch_events.description: A message was pinned or unpinned.

dispatch_events.name: MESSAGE_ACK
dispatch_events.description: The user's read state advanced on another device.

dispatch_events.name: READ_STATE_UPDATE
dispatch_events.description: Complete versioned read-state snapshot targeted to the owning user's sessions; compare channel versions, never increment from this event.

dispatch_events.name: READ_STATE_SYNC
dispatch_events.description: Fresh certified read-state snapshots after resume replay and before RESUMED; merge by version to recover lost publication.

dispatch_events.name: USER_GUILD_SETTINGS_UPDATE
dispatch_events.description: The current user's notification settings for a guild or their DMs changed (sent to that user only).

dispatch_events.name: USER_NOTE_UPDATE
dispatch_events.description: The current user's private note about a user changed (sent to the author only).

dispatch_events.name: RELATIONSHIP_ADD
dispatch_events.description: A relationship was created or changed.

dispatch_events.name: CHANNEL_RECIPIENT_ADD
dispatch_events.description: A user was added to a group DM.

dispatch_events.name: CHANNEL_RECIPIENT_REMOVE
dispatch_events.description: A user was removed from a group DM.

dispatch_events.name: SESSIONS_REPLACE
dispatch_events.description: The user's set of active sessions changed.

dispatch_events.name: INTERACTION_CREATE
dispatch_events.description: A user invoked an application command or component.

dispatch_events.name: AUDIT_LOG_ENTRY_CREATE
dispatch_events.description: An audit log entry was created.

bus_only_events.name: VOICE_MEMBER_MOVE
bus_only_events.description: A moderator moved a member to another voice channel or disconnected them; the gateway applies it to the member voice session and never dispatches it.

bus_only_events.name: BAN_MESSAGE_PURGE
bus_only_events.description: A user was banned with delete_message_seconds; the messages service purges their recent messages in the listed channels. The gateway ignores it and never dispatches it.

bus_only_events.name: SESSION_REVOKE
bus_only_events.description: Login sessions were revoked; the gateway closes the live connections of those sessions and never dispatches it.

bus_only_events.name: VOICE_QUALITY
bus_only_events.description: A voice quality sample from a client or a voice node.

bus_only_events.name: USAGE_TICK
bus_only_events.description: A periodic usage counter consumed by the admin aggregator.

opcodes.name: IDENTIFY
opcodes.description: Authenticates with the voice token from VOICE_SERVER_UPDATE.

opcodes.name: SELECT_PROTOCOL
opcodes.description: The client's ICE/DTLS parameters and codecs.

opcodes.name: READY
opcodes.description: SSRC, media endpoint and simulcast streams assigned to the client.

opcodes.name: HEARTBEAT
opcodes.description: Keeps the voice connection alive.

opcodes.name: SESSION_DESCRIPTION
opcodes.description: Server ICE-lite parameters; the client synthesises the remote SDP from them.

opcodes.name: SPEAKING
opcodes.description: Speaking indicator.

opcodes.name: HEARTBEAT_ACK
opcodes.description: Acknowledges a heartbeat, echoing its nonce.

opcodes.name: HELLO
opcodes.description: Sent on connect; carries the heartbeat interval.

opcodes.name: CLIENTS_CONNECT
opcodes.description: Users who joined the call.

opcodes.name: VIDEO
opcodes.description: Video/screen-share SSRC announcement.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_DISCONNECT
opcodes.description: A user left the call.

opcodes.name: MEDIA_SINK_WANTS
opcodes.description: Requested quality (0-100) per SSRC; selects the simulcast layer. Screen shares are delivered only after opting in with the screen SSRC at quality > 0.

opcodes.name: DAVE_PREPARE_TRANSITION
opcodes.description: A DAVE protocol transition is about to happen.

opcodes.name: DAVE_EXECUTE_TRANSITION
opcodes.description: Execute a previously prepared transition.

opcodes.name: DAVE_TRANSITION_READY
opcodes.description: The client is ready for the transition.

opcodes.name: DAVE_PREPARE_EPOCH
opcodes.description: A new MLS epoch is about to start.

opcodes.name: DAVE_MLS_EXTERNAL_SENDER
opcodes.description: The voice server's MLS external sender credential.

opcodes.name: DAVE_MLS_KEY_PACKAGE
opcodes.description: The client's MLS key package.

opcodes.name: DAVE_MLS_PROPOSALS
opcodes.description: MLS proposals to append or revoke.

opcodes.name: DAVE_MLS_COMMIT_WELCOME
opcodes.description: An MLS commit with an optional welcome.

opcodes.name: DAVE_MLS_ANNOUNCE_COMMIT
opcodes.description: The winning commit for a transition.

opcodes.name: DAVE_MLS_WELCOME
opcodes.description: An MLS welcome for a joining member.

opcodes.name: DAVE_MLS_INVALID_COMMIT
opcodes.description: The received commit or welcome was invalid; the client asks to be re-added.

opcodes.name: STREAM_VIEWERS
opcodes.description: Sent to the streamer only: the full list of users watching their screen share, re-sent on every change.

sfu_commands.name: create_session
sfu_commands.description: Creates (or, after an SFU restart, re-creates) a media session.

sfu_commands.name: set_sink_wants
sfu_commands.description: Updates simulcast layer preferences for a session.

sfu_events.name: session_created
sfu_events.description: Reply to create_session with the SFU's ICE/DTLS parameters.

sfu_events.name: speaking
sfu_events.description: Voice activity detected on an SSRC.

sfu_events.name: stream_viewers
sfu_events.description: The opted-in viewers of a screen share changed; carries the full list.

error_codes.name: UNAUTHORIZED
error_codes.description: Unauthorized. Provide a valid token and try again.

error_codes.name: VERIFICATION_REQUIRED
error_codes.description: You need to verify your account in order to perform this action.

error_codes.name: MISSING_PERMISSIONS
error_codes.description: You lack permissions to perform that action.

error_codes.name: DELIVERY_MODE_CONFLICT
error_codes.description: Discordy: the channel uses a non-standard delivery mode; send over gateway op 20 or op 22.

MessageType.description: Message types (Discord values) used by Discordy.

MessageFlags.description: Message flags (Discord values) used by Discordy. SUPPRESS_EMBEDS hides link previews; SUPPRESS_NOTIFICATIONS (@silent) sends without push, desktop or mention notifications; IS_VOICE_MESSAGE identifies a voice recording.

AttachmentFlags.description: Attachment flags (Discord values) used by Discordy. IS_SPOILER blurs the media until the viewer reveals it.

AuditLogEvent.description: Audit log action types used by Discordy, including Voics extensions.
